call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Data & Applications Growth & Multi-Year Pharma Bookings
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Eric, Data & Applications grew 33% and bookings surpassed $550M YTD with the BMS deal. How much of this is upfront software licensing versus recurring milestone ARR, and what is the pipeline for additional pharma partnerships?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Eric Lefkofsky (CEO) responded: 'Our data licensing model is increasingly institutionalized. Pharma partners are not buying one-off datasets; they are integrating Tempus multimodal data directly into their clinical oncology pipelines. The Merck, Moderna, and BMS collaborations are multi-year structural agreements with high renewal rates and expanding per-study licensing fees.'

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: MRD Ramp, Reimbursement Coverage & Diagnostics Margins
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Jim, with MRD tests reaching 12,000 units and gross margins expanding to 64.8%, what is your timeline for broad Medicare and commercial coverage for pan-cancer recurrence monitoring?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Jim Rogers (CFO) noted that Tempus has secured key MolDX local coverage determinations across colorectal and breast cancer indications, with broader pan-cancer dossiers submitted. He highlighted that lab automation is driving significant cost-of-sequencing efficiencies, allowing gross margins to scale toward 68%-70% over the next 18 months.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Cash Runway, Path to Positive FCF & CapEx Discipline
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: With $854M in cash and marketable securities and Q3 Adjusted EBITDA hitting $25.6M, when do you anticipate crossing into positive quarterly Free Cash Flow after CapEx and lease commitments?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_answer: Jim Rogers (CFO) stated that Tempus expects operating cash burn to continue contracting sequentially, targeting sustained positive operating cash flow by mid-2027. He emphasized that the $854M balance sheet provides ample runway without any need for external dilutive equity financing.
